decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel builds directly on the firm's established cheese-making know-how and organic milk supply, so the firm can read its results and refine it, even though the website no longer shows it after 2019.

The spicy cheese line draws on existing cheese competence, but its absence from the website and the earlier withdrawal of the similar onion-and-pepper cheese suggest it may be trimmed rather than dropped outright.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the cheese range and lets the firm keep learning soft-cheese production, although it has not been visible since its 2018 launch.

Washed-rind soft cheese is the furthest from the firm's absorptive base, it has no visible traction since launch, and the firm has little R&D or research cooperation to improve it, so its resources are better used in the core business.
